cand.title: CRS 2027 Annual Meeting & Exposition
cand.excerpt: Strong organized hospitality-demand mechanism and confirmed Toronto date; venue commitment reduces current-edition accessibility.
cand.selectionWhy: Ledger shows competitor venue/hotel: Sheraton Centre Toronto

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Jessica Hayes, Meeting Manager, is the primary verified meetings-team contact for routing accommodation and ancillary-event discussions; her contract-signing authority is not published. Gabrielle Copperwheat, Chief Executive Officer, is a senior account-development and governance contact; authority over this hotel contract is not established. Tara Locantore, Meeting Coordinator, is an operational alternative. Amanda Bray, Senior Industry Relations Manager on the 2027 page, handles sponsorship/exhibiting questions and may route exhibitor hospitality discussions; sponsorship responsibility does not establish housing procurement authority.
findings.futureEdition: Officially scheduled July 12–15, 2027, in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, within the requested horizon. These are activity dates: CRS lists Start Date July 12, 2027, 7:00 AM and End Date July 15, 2027, 7:00 PM. The edition is upcoming as of November 15, 2026, not a historical date rolled forward. The 2027 registration policy references a 2028 Annual Meeting, but no official 2028 dates, city or venue were located; do not present 2028 as a confirmed Toronto opportunity.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel capacities: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown cannot host this entire conference or be its exclusive housing provider. CRS markets 1,700+ global attendees; that is a promotional expected audience, not confirmed registration or room demand. A 157-room Harbourfront hotel with an approximately 240-theatre largest room is potentially suitable only for a separately agreed small delegate/speaker/exhibitor allocation, executive lodging or small side meetings. Approximately 15–109 peak rooms is a sales-test range supplied by the hotel brief, NOT published CRS demand. This is a city scientific conference, not a resort programme. MTCC proximity is not a direct demand argument because the committed venue is Sheraton Centre. The hotel’s official listing says “Restaurant and Lounge closed until further notice”; do not promise catering or receptions without operational confirmation.
findings.venueCommitments: Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel, 123 Queen Street West, Toronto, ON M5H 2M9, Canada; CRS also spells it Sheraton Center Toronto Hotel. This is the committed meeting venue AND official conference hotel with a negotiated CRS 2027 room block. It is in Toronto proper, downtown, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. CRS states: “By staying within the official CRS room block, you help CRS meet its commitments to the conference hotel”. Sheraton Centre is the only named edition-specific committed hotel located in the reviewed official housing material. No other competing Toronto hotel was verified as committed.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified recent annual sequence: Las Vegas 2023, Bologna 2024, Philadelphia 2025, Lisbon 2026, Toronto 2027. These represent different cities and both hotel and convention-centre venues. CRS also records Toronto in 1987 and Montreal in 2022. This establishes international rotation and a prior Toronto occurrence, not an annual Toronto series or a predictable Toronto return interval. No future Toronto cycle after 2027 was verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Official host-hotel/block pathway, not an open hotel RFP. CRS says: “CRS has worked to secure the best available rate at the official conference hotel, the Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel” and asks attendees to book “through the official CRS housing link”. The only named hotel is Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel; group name CRS 2027; official reservation link https://book.passkey.com/event/51315211/owner/6564/home?utm_campaign=301319573 . Hotel reservations contact: sher.yyztc.ressupport@sheratonhotels.com, +1.888.627.7175. CRS says “Registration, Abstract Submission, and Housing are OPEN!” This means attendee booking is open, NOT that sourcing additional hotels is open. No 2027 housing bureau or agency is identified in the reviewed material. CRS warns that it has not authorized third-party companies to contact attendees. Numeric room rates, cutoff, contracted peak rooms, room nights and pickup were not available in the accessible hotel/booking text.
findings.organizationStructure: CRS is the event-owning international interdisciplinary not-for-profit society, not a hotel, corporate incentive planner or DMC. Its bylaws authorize retaining an association-management company and chief staff executive. Association Headquarters identifies Gabrielle Copperwheat as Chief Executive Officer of CRS and describes her society leadership responsibilities. Keep society owner, management support, Sheraton venue/housing supplier and the Passkey reservation platform distinct. No separate 2027 PCO/DMC or housing bureau was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Sheraton has both venue integration and a CRS-negotiated block, and CRS expressly discourages booking outside it because of its hotel commitments. No sold-out notice, overflow requirement, waitlist, unmet rooms, additional-hotel solicitation or released inventory was verified. The 1,700+ promotional audience cannot be converted to room nights or used to assume Sheraton cannot accommodate demand. No edition-specific commitment was found for Westin Harbour Castle, Hotel X, Hyatt Regency Toronto, Le Méridien Toronto Pinnacle, Fairmont Royal York, Marriott City Centre, Hilton Toronto or InterContinental Toronto Centre; these are not verified event hotels.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Jessica Hayes at jhayes@controlledreleasesociety.org, copying meetings@controlledreleasesociety.org, with a short, non-displacing proposal: ask whether CRS wants a sanctioned small supplemental block or speaker/exhibitor lodging for July 12–15, 2027; request permitted room-night pattern, peak rooms, rate parameters, pickup trigger and decision-maker. Do not quote a block as available until hotel inventory is checked. If no 2027 need, ask when future Toronto host-city/secondary-housing decisions are made and seek permission to remain in the account file. Use Gabrielle Copperwheat for senior relationship development and Amanda Bray only for industry/exhibitor routing. Verify restaurant/lounge and any catered function capability before offering side events.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Limited and conditional for 2027. The principal venue and official housing block are already committed to Sheraton Centre. No evidence establishes an open replacement bid or request for an extra hotel. An ancillary or overflow role for Radisson is physically plausible but commercially unverified; pursue only with organizer permission and demonstrated need, not by representing the hotel as official housing or soliciting attendees as an authorized CRS agent.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Relationship-development potential only. Verified annual international rotation permits asking about future host-city selection and supplemental housing procurement, but does not establish a future Toronto return, open sourcing window or suitability for full-event capture. The 2028 meeting is mentioned in registration rollover policy without a verified date/city; no within-horizon 2028 Toronto opportunity can be claimed. For a future Toronto cycle, compete for a small secondary lodging or ancillary role, not the full conference.
